name: Morningstar Credit Analytics

Through our MCP-powered connector, clients can explore cross-asset coverage—including funds, equities, and beyond, enhanced by forward-looking insights from our global analyst teams. Access trusted, unbiased intelligence to support investment decisions, due diligence, and portfolio strategy in one seamless experience.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Morningstar Credit Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Morningstar Credit Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.analytics.credit.morningstar.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Morningstar Credit Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Morningstar Credit Analytics lists 22 MCP tools, including DealSearch, DealDetail, DealLoans, DealBonds, DealTopLoansSummary, DealLossForecast, DealCommentary, DealNoteworthyMetrics, DealBreakdowns, DealSurveillanceDashboardUi, LoanSearch, and LoanDetails.

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Morningstar Credit Analytics in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Morningstar Credit Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Morningstar Credit Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Morningstar Credit Analytics is developed by Morningstar Credit Analytics. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
